ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Based on the diagram showing a partial food web, how will the rodent population change if the birds of prey become extinct?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a partial food web. In the lower left there is a “Rodent” label, indicating rodents; above it there is a “Bird of Prey” label, indicating birds of prey. In the figure there is an arrow pointing from the direction of the rodent to the bird of prey, indicating that the bird of prey preys on or depends on the rodent. Reasoning: If the bird of prey becomes extinct, the natural enemies of the rodents decrease, and the pressure of being preyed on is reduced, so more rodents will survive and reproduce. Therefore the rodent population will increase.
